item.title: Supercommunicators: Mastering the 3 Communication Channels
item.description: Charles Duhigg's framework for unlocking connection: practical, emotional, and social conversations — and why matching the right channel is the secret of supercommunicators.

item.title: Structured Expression: The Art of Speaking to the Point
item.description: A comprehensive guide to structured expression: pyramid principles, seven frameworks (PREP, STAR, FABE, SCQA, AIDA, SPIN, GPEC), workplace templates, and a 30-day training plan.

item.title: Start with Why: The Golden Circle That Separates Great Leaders from the Rest
item.description: Simon Sinek's Golden Circle reveals why Apple, Martin Luther King Jr., and the Wright Brothers inspired millions while others with better resources failed. People don't buy what you do — they buy why you do it.
